q: What are the three parts of the operating system in this bonus lab?
explanation: Capture keeps one list of repetitive, language-heavy work; Prompt saves the prompt, context and quality checklist that produced a good result; Review spends ten minutes each Friday improving one workflow.

q: After a prompt produces a good result, what should you save?
options: The prompt, the context and the quality checklist
The name of the model used
explanation: The second part of the system saves the whole recipe — the prompt, the context and the quality checklist that produced a good result — so you can repeat it, not just the prompt on its own.

q: What is the final step of the bonus task for your chosen recurring task?
options: Delete the task from your capture list
Run it once, measure the time saved, then teach it to one colleague
Ask a manager for written approval
explanation: The bonus task is to document the trigger, inputs, prompt, verification checklist and final owner, run it once, measure the time saved, then teach it to one colleague — spreading the system, not hoarding it.
